descriptionHtml:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure

The Best Way to begin exploring OCI

For Every Oracle DBA

Available in HML Mode

HML - Hybrid Mode Learning

(a Special Mode of Learning for Excellence)

More about the course

This course is to transform YOU from

a Traditional Oracle Database environment to an Oracle Cloud environment.

Master the components of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure & services that

enable YOU to transform YOUR customer to a Cloud environment, a present-day requirement.

This course is framed to equip YOU, the Training Participant

with facilities in OCI that helps in choosing YOU as a First-Hand Consultant by YOUR Customer.
